description:
The Faculty of Science and Humanities (FSH), SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST), Tiruchirappalli Campus, proudly welcomed 500+ first-year UG and PG students to the Academic Year 2026–27 at the SRM Auditorium under the visionary leadership of Dr. R. Raj Mohan, Director – Business Head India, University Champion & NexCen Program Leader, was introduced by Dr. Sudipta Kumar Pal, Vice Principal – Academics, Institute of Hotel Management. In his keynote address, Dr. Raj Mohan motivated the students to leverage the University's academic ecosystem, develop future-ready skills, embrace Artificial Intelligence, and begin preparing for successful careers from the very first day.

Seven student representatives shared their experiences and encouraged the freshers to actively participate in academics, skill development initiatives, and campus life.

The Vote of Thanks was proposed by Mr. J. Prince Antony, Vice Principal – Administration, Institute of Hotel Management, who expressed gratitude to the dignitaries, Chief Guest, faculty members, organizers, parents, and students for making the inaugural function a grand success.

The programme concluded with the National Anthem, marking the successful commencement of the Academic Year 2026–27

name: FDP on " Enhancing Teaching Excellence through Prompt Engineering and Generative AI" in association with IIT Guwahati  and E&ICT Academy from 7th to 11th December 2026.
description:

This FDP is designed to empower faculty members and research scholars with practical knowledge and hands-on experience in Prompt Engineering and Generative AI for education. The programme covers Prompt Engineering for Teaching and Learning, Generative AI Tools for Education, AI-enabled Digital Teaching Practices, Hands-on Learning and Practical Applications, and strategies for Enhancing Teaching Effectiveness using Generative AI. No prior programming or AI experience is required.

The programme is coordinated by Dr. L. Josephine Usha, Assistant Professor, and Dr. K. R. Saranya, Assistant Professor, SRM IST Tiruchirappalli.

Faculty members and research scholars are encouraged to participate and explore the transformative potential of Generative AI in modern education. Registration can be completed through the E&ICT Academy portal at https://eict.iitg.ac.in/academy/programmes.
